summary: P1.3 Core stage-3 re-point — the next P1 piece after the accepted Plugin stage-1/2 re-point (P1-Plugin done, byte-identical proven). Re-point the Core UnifiedValidator stage-3 field gate to read its params from the RecipeAuthoringSpec gateRules table instead of inline literals, byte-identical. Per design B.P1.3 replace the inline markdown length floor 200, the code-block-or-file-ref regexes, the coreCode bracket predicate (close-brace close-paren close-bracket), the generic-title regex, and the code-fingerprint normalization (UnifiedValidator.ts around 185-240 and codeFingerprint) with reads from the module. Field-presence already reads V3_FIELD_SPEC and stays unchanged. IMPORTANT scope note: the module gateRules table currently exposes only 2 stage-3 entries (uniqueness plus one) plus the fingerprint helper and the generic-title regex; UnifiedValidator does NOT yet import the module. If any stage-3 param UnifiedValidator needs is not yet a clean module export, ADD it to the RecipeAuthoringSpec module first with the byte-identical value from UnifiedValidator current inline code (this completes the P0.3 stage-3 lift), then re-point. Behavior must stay byte-identical: capture a stage-3 behavior baseline first (a small corpus of submissions hitting each stage-3 error: missing required field, content not object, reasoning not object, kind invalid, markdown too short, markdown needs code or file ref, coreCode incomplete, title too generic, the three uniqueness duplicates) and assert the re-pointed UnifiedValidator produces the identical errors array; if any byte differs, STOP because a value was reinterpreted not moved, and return needs-review with the diff. This also enables the A.6 drift test number 4 (guidance 200 floor and required-field list equal the module markdown.lengthFloor and getAllRequiredFieldNames). Acceptance on node 22: Core build, build:check, and the UnifiedValidator/stage-3 test suite green with byte-identical output; the gate-constants drift snapshot green. Note the Core npm run check is red ONLY on the 3 pre-existing out-of-scope lint:naming files (project-context-capabilities.ts, recipe-context-capabilities.ts, test-fixtures.ts) — do NOT touch or rename those (out of scope, public exports); use build:check plus test plus drift as your green bar and note the carve-out in backfill. Gates byte-identical and not relaxed; main only, no push or tag or version bump; FieldSpec field-presence unchanged; the dead recipe-evidence-gate duplicate is out of scope. Producer-consumer: Core consumes its own module; this completes the gate-side re-point (stage-1/2 Plugin done, stage-3 Core here); the in-process parity flatten P1.4 follows as a separate wave. Backfill the Core commit hash, the stage-3 byte-identical proof, raw build:check and test output, and which stage-3 params you added to the module versus already present.
